description: Search deali.co.il's curated catalog of AliExpress deals for Israeli shoppers. Returns matching products with prices in ILS (₪), discount %, rating, a buy link (deali.co.il affiliate link), and a coupon code when the seller has one that works now. Titles and descriptions are in Hebrew — Hebrew queries match best, but English works for brand/model names.
